notes.note: Dean has been sold in the 50-70 range over the last couple of months and those holding him would be using him with all the injuries.
Dean is playing good footy but it isn't resulting in big SuperCoach scores. His 15 disposals this week saw a handy 60.
Dean had the job on Ben King and had 13 disposals in the process. Not a huge score but at this stage you are looping him or using him as the emergency.
Dean had the role on McStay for the game and did a solid job holding him to just the 6 touches while collecting 15 of his own.
Top score of the season from Dean with his 8 marks and 15 disposals (86%) this week which will see that BE remain low. However with the bye this week you may want to trade him.
Dean backed up that good score from the week before with a 15 disposal effort whilst only having 13m gained!
Dean posted his best score of the season by some distance. He took 7 marks and used the footy well going at 83%. Whilst he has a good BE and scored well he is one to still look at trading.
Dean posted what is his best for the last four games but still not enough for us to have him. His BE is at 35 with an average over the last 5 of 42 it is just about time to trade.
Dean continues to leak cash with an 8 disposal game this week. He must be moved out of your side.
Dean continues to struggle to score and is a must trade out.
Dean had just 6 disposals and 4 marks with this his lowest score of the year. His BE has risen to 53 and he is unfieldable. Move him on.
